text_block_list.text:
It's nearly time for training, but Fuji
Kiseki is out
doing some last-minute
shopping.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Okay! The only thing left is—
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Um... You're Фудзи Кисэки, right? I'm a big
fan! I've
been following all your races!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you so much! I'm
honored.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how lucky I am to have
caught the
attention of such a cute pony
such as yourself.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My family and friends all love you too!
Could I
get an autograph, please?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
But of course. I'll gladly sign as many as
you'd like
for as long as I still have
command over my arm.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Aaah! You're so cool! U-um, could I have
a
hundred autographs, then?!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Oh, I knew I was being too greedy... Sniffle.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Oh, no, it's all right! I can do a hundred!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
This is an awkward place to wait, so why
don't we
have some tea at a cafe while I
sign your
autographs?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And so, Фудзи Кисэки ends up completely
neglecting
her training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
